packageRules.description: Terraform is pinned in mise.toml (mise manager) and in each root's versions.tf required_version (terraform manager). Group them so one PR bumps every copy together; the contract validator rejects a PR that moves only one.

Freeze everything under template/**. Those files are seed values for projects generated from this template; each generated project ships its own Renovate config and owns its bumps. Managing them here too makes `copier update` conflict, because copier's 3-way merge sees the template render and the downstream file moving the same literal to different values.
